item.title: ESB working to restore power to 140 customers in Donegal
item.description: The ESB is working to restore electricity to 140 premises in Donegal following two separate faults. An issue affecting 53 properties in Kilcar is expected to be resolved by 5:45pm. Meanwhile, power should be restored for the remaining 87 homes and businesses in Derrybeg.
